reader_summary.overview: Today, we will be diving into energy giant, Exxon Mobil. The origins of Exxon date back to John D. Exxon was spun out in 1911 as the Standard Oil of New Jersey, and in 1998, Exxon merged with Mobil.

key_points.text: Exxon was spun out in 1911 as the Standard Oil of New Jersey, and in 1998, Exxon merged with Mobil.
To break down the rich history of Exxon, I am joined by Arjun Murti, a long-time energy analyst, and investor.
During our conversation, we dive deep into the supermajor business and how that drove Exxon’s century-long success.
